TACHFINE (1967-2024) is a data set listed in Morocco national open data portal (data.gov.ma), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Agence du Bassin Hydraulique de Souss Massa. Ce fichier présente la pluie journalière de la station B.Y.T. TACHFINE pour la période de 1967 à 2024. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Agence du Bassin Hydraulique de Souss Massa. Its tags are journalière, pluie, station, tachfine. It offers 61 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-ma-portal.
